raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate progressive, diffuse bilateral involvement with multiple fluffy infiltrates and nodular opacities over time. This radiographic pattern is characteristic of the aggressive, multinodular form of bronchioloalveolar carcinoma (now termed invasive mucinous adenocarcinoma), which typically carries a poor prognosis due to its extensive spread.
